natural_language_statement: For real weights w indexed by a finite set of d coordinates and a real height H, define the finite weak simplex of natural exponent vectors using coordinate ranges up to the natural floor of H/w_i and the inequality sum_i w_i a_i <= H. Define the strict simplex by filtering this finite weak simplex with sum_i w_i a_i < H. These exact finite sets supply the row and column domains of the interpolation matrix; no positivity or asymptotic theorem is asserted here.
